context: Reference implementation: block lambdas in Optional.map, collector downstream, and formatting callbacks.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates HarvestSummaries.java with the three methods, the four nested records, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves summary semantics
checklist.description: noteFor returns empty for an absent plot and computes whole days and the readiness threshold correctly; statsByVariety counts crates, sums kilograms, and rounds the average to one decimal; crateLabels keeps encounter order and the exact label format.

checklist.name: Optional mapping uses a named helper
checklist.description: The Optional.map callback is a method reference or one-expression lambda that calls a named method building the HarvestNote (for example plot -> toNote(plot, today)); the day arithmetic and readiness branching are not written as a block lambda inside map.

checklist.name: Downstream reduction uses a named helper
checklist.description: The groupingBy downstream (for example collectingAndThen(toList(), HarvestSummaries::toStats) or an equivalent named collector helper) delegates the crate count, total, and rounded average to a named method; no block lambda with local variables sits inside the collector call.

checklist.name: Label formatting uses glue
checklist.description: The map callback producing labels is a method reference or a single-expression lambda without braces; a long single expression counts as fully meeting this item. Only a block lambda with braces, local variables, or statements fails it.

checklist.name: No block lambdas anywhere
checklist.description: No callback body in the file uses braces or continues onto further lines; extracted helpers contain plain code rather than another block lambda.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, caching, parallelism, extra public API, or dependency changes.
